## Architecture
- `SharedMemory` acts as a thread-safe, global in-memory store accessible concurrently by all agents.
- Persistence layer uses a periodic `time.Ticker` to flush dirty state to disk.
- `RepoMemoryStore` binds a repository-scoped view to the global `SharedMemory` instance.
- `GlobalCtx` centralizes runtime environment state and injects `ProjectPath` into LLM system prompts.

## Patterns
- MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control) manages message history and topic subscriptions.
- Ticker-based periodic I/O decouples save operations from agent message throughput.
- Fallback configuration applies OS-level defaults when TOML sections are missing.
- Filesystem path serves as the canonical repository identifier instead of a UUID or hash.
- Binary-embedded config templates (`//go:embed`) provide base settings without external files.

## Conventions
- Shared memory state file follows `.shared_memory.json` naming at the project root.
- Message buffer defaults to 500 entries; explicitly initialized to 100 in `app.go`.
- Keyword dictionary defaults to `{HomeDir}/.codeactor/keywords.txt` with `DictTypePrefix` matching.
- Persistence only triggers when the `dirty` flag is true, avoiding unnecessary disk writes.
- 5-second interval standardizes flush frequency across runs.

## Dependencies
- Go standard library: `sync` (RWMutex, WaitGroup, Ticker), `os`, `filepath`, `time`, `slog`.
- Internal packages: `internal/memory`, `internal/agents`, `internal/config`, `internal/globalctx`.

## Gotchas
- Shared memory persistence logs a warning and continues on first run if the file cannot be created.
- `NewSharedMemory` forces a minimum `maxSize` of 500 when input is ≤ 0.
- Tying repo identity to `ProjectPath` breaks if the working directory is renamed or moved.
- `[keywords]` default values (including `HotReload = false`) are only applied when the entire TOML section is absent.
- MVCC versioning and KV store share the same mutex pool; heavy concurrent writes may serialize access.

## Key Files
- `internal/app/app.go`: Initializes `SharedMemory(maxSize=100)`, configures 5s persistence, and wires `RepoMemoryStore`.
- `internal/memory/shared.go`: Defines `SharedMemory` struct, MVCC state, subscription routing, and ticker-driven persistence.
- `internal/globalctx/global_context.go`: Manages `ProjectPath` assignment and prompt formatting injection.
- `internal/config/config.go`: Parses TOML, resolves `os.UserHomeDir()`, and applies keyword fallbacks.
- `internal/config/default_config.toml`: Embedded baseline configuration compiled into the binary.
